note: Trace form (research/trace-harness.md): the L01a SQL twins, run against PostgreSQL with the data seed.sql makes at 1x and 10x, by scripts/trace.sh. Each request is sent three times, one after another (a warm-up, then two measured), with pg_stat_statements reset before each. n is the items a request handles at 1x; at 10x it is ten times that. items says where the harness counts them: in the response, in the request body, or as lines of a streamed response; null when the request handles a fixed number. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other request is a decoy, in both twins. linked: the trace finding must agree with a static finding on the route and the statement.
